name: Phase-Controlled Laser Pointing for Swept Displays
definition: A pointing method for swept volumetric displays where the laser pointer's depth is controlled by adjusting the phase of the laser pulse relative to the display's sweeping screen frequency, using an analog joystick.
summary: Phase-controlled laser pointing uses a joystick to adjust laser pulse phase relative to a swept display's frequency, enabling precise manual control of a discrete dot's vertical position.
